Material platforms

NeoCell

Structure at rest. Flow in motion.

Cellulose-based materials developed for rheology, suspension, texture, adhesion and formulation structure.

NeoCell is built around the physical behaviour of fibrillated cellulose, creating structure without depending only on bulk viscosity.

PURE — Formulation & personal care
GROW — Agricultural formulation

NeoNilam

Start with more than water.

Plant-derived nutrient liquids designed as starting materials for agricultural formulations.

NeoNilam gives agricultural-input companies a more functional place to begin when developing crop-nutrition and biostimulant products.

BASE — Flexible formulation base
BALANCE — More defined nutrient starting point
